blog_title: How to Check T-Shirt GSM at Home — 220 GSM vs 160 GSM Fraud Exposed for Bulk Buyers
caption:
₹1 lakh order. 500 pieces. Completely rejected. 😬

Bought 200 GSM fabric from a supplier. Felt thin. Checked it — barely 160 GSM. Client said no. ₹140 fabric + ₹60 stitching + ₹100 print = ₹300 wasted per piece.

Never ordered samples. Never weighed the fabric.

Here's the fix: Cut 1 square meter, weigh it. That's your GSM. Always sample first, then bulk.

Save this post if you're sourcing your next order 👇
